title: Filling the Void: Adding Life After Subtracting Work
coreMove: Subtract work, then add chosen life: learning, service, relationships, and challenge keep freedom from turning into anxious make-work.

exampleSpecs.stakes: The business can run during absence, but the owner may rebuild work to calm himself.
exampleSpecs.requiredBeat: Use the overseas one-hour Monday email rule to expose the emotional void after operations succeed.

exampleSpecs.stakes: A passive trip may sour into boredom unless contribution creates local ties.
exampleSpecs.requiredBeat: Use volunteering and language as active commitments that replace work as scaffolding.

exampleSpecs.audience: a founder who keeps adding metrics
exampleSpecs.stakes: Extra optimization may be anxiety disguised as stewardship.
exampleSpecs.requiredBeat: Use Monday email and business absence to distinguish needed oversight from invented work.

exampleSpecs.audience: a consultant with new free mornings
exampleSpecs.stakes: The reader may turn free time into another professional scoreboard.

exampleSpecs.stakes: Recovered time can still be lost if attention remains tied to work signals.

exampleSpecs.audience: a high performer entering a sabbatical
